data.exact_reserve_text: The tables below show the Syndicate's cumulative incurred claims development, including both claims notified and incurred but not reported for each underwriting year, together with the cumulative payments to date on a gross and net of reinsurance basis at the balance sheet date.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) with Enstar's Starstone Syndicate 2008
prior_year_events.impact_description: Transfer of all earned 2015 and prior business, resulting in a reduction of gross claims outstanding for those years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves amounting to GBP 29.57 million, primarily attributable to the 2016 year of account. This movement is derived from the claims development table for the business retained by the syndicate. A significant event affecting the overall reserve base was the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) agreement in 2018, which transferred all earned 2015 and prior business to another syndicate, resulting in a substantial reduction of gross claims outstanding for those years.
data.data_quality_notes: The syndicate entered into a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) agreement in 2018 for all earned 2015 and prior business. This significantly reduced the gross claims outstanding at the start of 2018 and means the prior year development figure only reflects movements on the retained 2016 year of account, as older years were transferred.
